knowledge:
- key_parameters: gsnorm=Specifies global scaling normalization method ("none", "median", "mean", "meanlog") in mmgmos, gmoExon, gmhta, and igmoExon ;; exontype=Specifies the species chip type ("Human", "Mouse", "Rat") in gmoExon and igmoExon ;; condition=Specifies whether to calculate gene expression values separately by condition ("Yes" or "No") in igmoExon ;; cl=A snow cluster object passed to pumaComb, gmoExon, or gmhta to enable parallel processing ;; clusters=The number of clusters to identify in pumaClust ;; mincls/maxcls=The minimum and maximum number of clusters to identify in pumaClustii
- alternatives: rma or mas5.0 (via affy/oligo)=Traditional summarisation methods that provide only point estimates; prefer mmgmos or PMmmgmos when probe-level uncertainty propagation is desired ;; limma=Standard differential expression package; prefer pumaDE (PPLR/IPPLR) to incorporate probe-level uncertainty, which improves accuracy especially for weakly expressed genes ;; prcomp=Standard PCA; prefer pumaPCA to account for expression-level uncertainty ;; standard clustering=Prefer pumaClust or pumaClustii (Student's t mixture model) to incorporate measurement error and replicate information
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing Affymetrix GeneChip datasets (3' arrays, exon arrays, or HTA 2.0 arrays) and wanting to leverage probe-level measurement uncertainty to improve the robustness and accuracy of PCA, clustering, and differential expression analysis.
- pitfalls: Running mmgmos with gsnorm="none" requires subsequent normalization using pumaNormalize before differential expression analysis to avoid artifacts ;; The original PPLR method (pumaComb) is computationally intensive for large datasets; use pumaCombImproved (IPPLR) or parallel processing via the snow package to reduce execution times ;; Remapped CDFs often result in probesets with very few probes, making uncertainty propagation highly critical but potentially highly variable.

workflows.name: standard_3_prime_array_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform summarisation, normalization, PCA, replicate combining, and differential expression analysis on standard Affymetrix 3' arrays.
workflows.stages: 1. Read CEL files and define phenotype data ;; 2. Summarise probe-level data using mmgmos ;; 3. Perform uncertainty-aware PCA ;; 4. Normalize expression levels ;; 5. Combine replicate arrays ;; 6. Identify differentially expressed genes using PPLR ;; 7. Plot expression levels with error bars
workflows.code:
library(oligo)
estrogenFilenames<-list.celfiles()
oligo.estrogen<-read.celfiles(celFiles)
pData(oligo.estrogen) <- data.frame(
    "estrogen"=c("absent","absent","present","present"
        ,"absent","absent","present","present")
,   "time.h"=c("10","10","10","10","48","48","48","48")
,   row.names=rownames(pData(oligo.estrogen))
)
eset_estrogen_mmgmos<-mmgmos(oligo.estrogen,gsnorm="none")
pumapca_estrogen <- pumaPCA(eset_estrogen_mmgmos)
plot(pumapca_estrogen,legend1pos="right",legend2pos="top",main="pumaPCA")
eset_estrogen_mmgmos_normd <- pumaNormalize(eset_estrogen_mmgmos)
eset_estrogen_comb <- pumaComb(eset_estrogen_mmgmos_normd)
pumaDERes <- pumaDE(eset_estrogen_comb)
toppumaDEIntGene <- topGenes(pumaDERes, contrast=7)
plotErrorBars(eset_estrogen_mmgmos_normd, toppumaDEIntGene)

workflows.name: exon_array_analysis
workflows.intent: Calculate gene and transcript expression levels from Affymetrix exon arrays.
input: exonFilenames (raw Affymetrix exon array CEL files)
SampleNameTable (tab-separated table with Celnames and Condition columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Read CEL files ;; 2. Calculate gene and transcript expression levels using gmoExon or igmoExon ;; 3. Write expression and standard error results to CSV files
workflows.code:
library(oligo)
exonFilenames<-c("C0006.CEL","C021.CEL"
                ,"F023_NEG.CEL","F043_NEG.CEL")
oligo.exon<-read.celfiles(exonFilenames)
eset_gmoExon<-gmoExon(oligo.exon,exontype="Human",gsnorm="none")
write.reslts(eset_gmoExon$gene, file="eset_gmoExon_gene")
write.reslts(eset_gmoExon$transcript, file="eset_gmoExon_transcript")

cel.path<-"cel.path"
SampleNameTable<-"SampleNameTable"
eset_igmoExon<-igmoExon(cel.path="cel.path",SampleNameTable="SampleNameTable"
                       , exontype="Human"
                       , gsnorm="none", condition="Yes")

workflows.name: hta_array_analysis
workflows.intent: Calculate gene and transcript expression levels from Affymetrix HTA 2.0 arrays.
input: celFiles (raw Affymetrix HTA 2.0 array CEL files)
workflows.stages: 1. Read CEL files ;; 2. Calculate gene and transcript expression levels using gmhta ;; 3. Write expression and standard error results to CSV files
workflows.code:
library(puma)
library(oligo)
oligo.hta<-read.celfiles(celFiles)
eset_gmhta<-gmhta(oligo.hta,gsnorm="none")
write.reslts(eset_gmhta$gene, file="eset_gmhta_gene")
write.reslts(eset_gmhta$transcript, file="eset_gmhta_transcript")

workflows.name: uncertainty_aware_clustering
workflows.intent: Cluster probe-sets taking into account expression-level uncertainties and replicate information.
input: eset_estrogen_mmgmos (ExpressionSet object with uncertainty from mmgmos)
workflows.stages: 1. Run pumaClust for standard clustering or pumaClustii for robust Student's t mixture model clustering with replicates ;; 2. Summarize cluster assignments and write results
workflows.code:
pumaClust_estrogen <- pumaClust(eset_estrogen_mmgmos, clusters=7)
summary(as.factor(pumaClust_estrogen$cluster))
pumaClust_estrogen$centers
write.csv(pumaClust_estrogen$cluster, file="pumaClust_clusters.csv")
